29. ALPENTOUR

Schladming Dachstein

17.-20. June 2027

[REGISTRATION opens on 15th of October 2026](https://alpen-tour.at/register/)

Welcome to the Alpentour Trophy

Experience one of Europe’s toughest yet most breathtaking mountain bike stage races in the heart of the Styrian Alps. Four days, challenging trails, stunning alpine views – and a unique spirit of freedom and camaraderie. Whether you’re a professional or a passionate amateur: at the Alpentour Trophy it’s not only about the time, it’s about the experience.

Whats included?

Starter presents & Alpentour t-shirt

Finisher-medal (for official finishers)

Official Raceguide – Magazine

GPS Tracks (5 days before the event) & profile sticker for your bike

Handle bar and jersey number (personalized ) & passive chip at the handle bar number & safety pins & cable ties

3 x dinner big buffet (Hohenhaustenne –
incl. winner ceremony, film and pictures of the day

Pasta party with big buffet after the last stage (Schafalm Planai)

Feeding: station every 25 km & at the Finish Area with local delicacies like “Leberkäse”, Kaiserscharrn, etc.

Prize drawing: Dirndl and Lederhose on Saturday

Shower Container at the Finish Area & free entry to the swimming pool in Schladming

Bike Wash Area & Chill out Area

Luggage shuttle at the 4th stage to Schafalm Planai

[ENTRY FEE & Packages](https://alpen-tour.at/entry-fee-and-packages/)

It’s not how good you are,
it’s how good you want to be

Become part of the Alpentour family.

Become part of one of Europe’s most iconic mountain bike stage races in the heart of the Austrian Alps. Four unforgettable days of riding, breathtaking landscapes, and a spirit of true camaraderie await you in Schladming-Dachstein. Spots are limited – register now and secure your chance to challenge yourself, share the passion, and create memories that will last a lifetime.
